text: During the time these agents converted 185,000 lines of C code into 340,000 lines of Rust code (I counted), we merged over 300 commits in the actual curl project. We actually improved curl during these a little more than three weeks. A little over 200 bugfixes actually. 200 bugfixes that none of those rust rewrites have. We also fixed a few vulnerabilities. In another month we have done another 200 and maybe fixed a few more vulnerabilities.
